prompt: In the style of a cinematic film still, the scene unfolds on a wet shipyard dock under heavy grey skies. On the far left stands a man in a yellow raincoat holding a clipboard tightly against his chest. Next to him, a woman in blue overalls points firmly at a rusted anchor chain lying on the ground. The chain is tangled around a large wooden crate positioned near the water's edge. In the center foreground, a boy in a striped shirt sits on a coiled rope, looking up at a seagull perched on a metal piling. The seagull looks back at the boy with intense curiosity. To the right of the boy, an old fisherman in a wool cap leans heavily on a walking stick, watching the horizon. Behind the fisherman, a brown dog rests its head on a stack of fishing nets. The nets are piled haphazardly next to a red buoy that has washed ashore. Further back, a crane operator in an orange vest gestures from the cab of a towering yellow crane. Below the crane, a mechanic in greasy coveralls hands a wrench to an apprentice in a white hard hat. The apprentice takes the tool while standing beside a massive steel hull section. Near the hull, a cat in a black collar jumps onto a low concrete barrier. A tourist in a floral dress stands next to the barrier, taking a photo with a silver camera. Another worker in a green helmet walks past them, carrying a lunchbox. Finally, a child in a pink jacket runs toward the group, clutching a toy boat. There is no sun visible in the sky. There is no clear water in the harbor.
